# Thomson Reuters Tax & Accounting

> Professional tax, accounting, and audit software solutions from Thomson Reuters, including ONESOURCE, UltraTax CS, and cloud-based practice management tools for firms and corporations.

Thomson Reuters Tax & Accounting provides comprehensive software platforms for tax compliance, workpaper automation, trade classification, and firm management. The site serves both corporate tax departments and accounting firms with solutions spanning income tax, indirect tax, audit automation, and advisory services.

## Key Topics

- ONESOURCE - Corporate tax compliance platform
- UltraTax CS - Professional tax preparation software
- SPBinder - Tax workpaper automation
- Onvio Firm Management - Cloud practice management
- Cloud Audit Suite - Audit automation tools
- Tax compliance and filing
- Accounting firm practice management
- Trade classification (HS/ECCN codes)
- AI-driven tax and audit automation
- Tax preparation outsourcing
- Professional development and training
- Advisory services transformation
- Year-end tax processes
- SYNERGY conference series
- Cryptocurrency tax treatment

## Core Tax Software Products

- [ONESOURCE Corporate Income Tax](https://tax.thomsonreuters.com/en/products/onesource-income-tax): ONESOURCE corporate income tax software for filing returns quickly
- [UltraTax CS Professional Tax Software](https://tax.thomsonreuters.com/en/products/ultratax-cs): UltraTax CS professional tax preparation software for firms
- [UltraTax CS Features](https://tax.thomsonreuters.com/en/products/ultratax-cs/features): UltraTax CS features for tax compliance and preparation
- [SPBinder Tax Workpaper Automation](https://tax.thomsonreuters.com/en/products/spbinder): SPBinder tax workpaper automation software for professionals
- [ONESOURCE Global Classification AI](https://tax.thomsonreuters.com/en/products/onesource-global-classification-ai): ONESOURCE Global Classification AI for HS/ECCN compliance

## Practice Management & Firm Solutions

- [Onvio Firm Management Features](https://tax.thomsonreuters.com/en/products/onvio-firm-management/features): Onvio Firm Management features for tax and accounting firms
- [Tax Preparation Outsource Services](https://tax.thomsonreuters.com/en/products/outsource): Tax preparation outsourcing services for accounting firms
- [SYNERGY Conference Series](https://tax.thomsonreuters.com/en/synergy/accounting-firms): SYNERGY conference series for accounting professionals
- [PPC Audit Guides](https://tax.thomsonreuters.com/en/accounting-solutions/c/ppc-audit-guides): PPC Audit Guides with practical guidance and checklists
